questions.question: What is a greatest common divisor of two polynomials?
options: A root shared by both polynomials
The sum of the two polynomials
Any polynomial with larger degree than both inputs.
questions.explanation: A GCD of two polynomials is a polynomial of greatest possible degree that divides both.
questions.source_support: Definition: a GCD is a polynomial of greatest possible degree that divides both $a(x)$ and $b(x)$.
questions.polish_notes: Quality round 9: rebalanced correct-answer positions to remove option-index guessing cue
option_explanations: A shared root is not itself the GCD (which is a polynomial factor).

The sum $a(x)+b(x)$ is a polynomial of degree at most $\max\{\deg a,\deg b\}$ built by adding coefficients, whereas a GCD is a common divisor of greatest degree, i.e. a polynomial $d$ with $d\mid a$ and $d\mid b$.
A divisor has degree at most that of the inputs, not larger.
